Pomegranate Smoothie
By: Diethood
Published: Friday, November 5, 2010 - 8:49am

Ingredients




1 cup Non-Fat Yogurt (check out my" Homemade Yogurt Recipe")
1 pomegranate
1 packet of Splenda Sweetener

Preparation

1 Cut the pomegranate in half, crosswise, and squeeze out the juice and seeds - as you would squeeze a lemon. 2 Combine all ingredients and throw them in a blender; mix well. 3 Pour in a glass and enjoy this refreshing drink.

About


A Foodista member suggested a "Pomegranate Milk Shake"... http://www.foodista.com/recipe/Q4KNDH5N/pomegranate-milk-shake
I played off that and made a "Pomegranate Smoothie"... it is sooo good.
Thanks to Foodista Member, Muhammad Irshad Ansari
